column1: # Intended changes since jigc 1.0.0-rc.24 (tag jigc-v1.0.0-rc.24, commit 91834b5e) — the list
# dev/regression-set reads, out of the candidate's commit: every test of that release's own
# suite that passes on its binary and fails on the candidate's must be a row here, or the
# check is red; and every test that fails on its own binary must be an exclusion row here,
# or the check is not green.
# One row per test, FOUR fields with ONE TAB between each, and no space around a field:
# A pointer is `commit:<full sha>` — a commit the candidate holds and the release does not —
# or `ruling:<path>#<the opening words of exactly one heading of that file>`. An EXCLUSION
# ROW has the same four fields: its third says why the test fails on its own binary, and
# its pointer is `excluded:<path>` — a committed line of this tool, of a run against the
# same release, that names the test among those that failed there. A row that points at
# nothing is refused, and the whole list with it (`dev/regression-set --help`).
